cases.purpose: Check invalid arguments, closed and unwritable descriptors, timeout bounds and the idle default.
cases.setup_script: /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import hashlib,os; a=bytes((i*73+19)%256 for i in range(32768+45)); b=bytes((i*37+11)%256 for i in range(16384)); assert len(a)==32813 and len(b)==16384 and 0 in a and max(a)>127; assert hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest()=="d5b60ff71ffd82d71e5cda06bb82482785283d64a95c7144049a61ed1d96cdb9" and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=="ce61cc72a84bd3526a8f955235c5f4f67439820d6ffb910b5ab07e54741262b8"; m,s=os.openpty(); assert os.isatty(m) and os.isatty(s); os.close(m); os.close(s)'
cases.oracle: Documented broker contract, independently created fixed bytes and Linux PTY/process observations. Setup controls the PTY facility and exact expected byte hashes; no candidate output defines expected behavior.
cases.comparison: Check usage and malformed-ID failures, protected array/integer outputs, closed and read-only descriptors, acceptance of 60000 ms with an already queued event, bounded default and explicit idle timeouts returning 124 and rejection of 60001.
cases.script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/terra-local-pty-broker-r3.py
root=$HOME/broker-root
P=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/terra-local-pty-proc-r3.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" prepare || exit 1
/usr/bin/mkdir -m 700 "$root" || exit 1
failed=0
mark() { if [[ $2 == 1 ]]; then printf '%s=PASS\n' "$1"; else printf '%s=FAIL\n' "$1"; failed=1; fi; }
await_file() { local j; for ((j=0;j<100;j++)); do [[ -f $HOME/$1 ]] && return 0; /usr/bin/sleep .05; done; return 1; }
mock=''
cleanup_owned() {
  ptybroker terminate "$root" one >"$HOME/trap-terminate.out" 2>"$HOME/trap-terminate.err" || :
  if [[ -n $mock ]]; then kill "$mock" 2>/dev/null || :; wait "$mock" 2>/dev/null || :; fi
  if [[ -f $HOME/broker-before.json ]]; then /usr/bin/python3 "$P" wait-gone "$HOME/broker-before.json" "$HOME/broker-trap-after.json" broker >>"$HOME/proc.err" 2>&1 || :; fi
}
trap cleanup_owned EXIT

ptybroker create "$root" one -- /usr/bin/python3 "$H" child quiet >"$HOME/create.log" 2>"$HOME/errors.log" || exit 1
creation=$(<"$HOME/create.log")
brokerpid=''
if [[ $creation =~ broker_pid=([0-9]+) ]]; then brokerpid=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}; fi
[[ $brokerpid =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || exit 1
/usr/bin/python3 "$P" snapshot-live "$HOME/broker-before.json" broker "$brokerpid" >"$HOME/proc.out" 2>"$HOME/proc.err" || exit 1
await_file quiet-ready || exit 1
ptybroker receive >"$HOME/missing.out" 2>"$HOME/missing.err"; missing=$?
ptybroker status "$root" 'bad/id' >"$HOME/bad-id.out" 2>"$HOME/bad-id.err"; bad=$?
printf -v long '%049d' 0
ptybroker status "$root" "$long" >"$HOME/long.out" 2>"$HOME/long.err"; longrc=$?
declare -a invalid=(keep)
ptybroker attach "$root" one observe invalid >"$HOME/array.out" 2>"$HOME/array.err"; arr=$?
declare -i integer=3
ptybroker attach "$root" one observe integer >"$HOME/int.out" 2>"$HOME/int.err"; intrc=$?
printf 'missing=%s bad_id=%s long_id=%s array_rc=%s array0=%q integer_rc=%s integer=%s\n' "$missing" "$bad" "$longrc" "$arr" "${invalid[0]}" "$intrc" "$integer" >"$HOME/error-observation.txt"
good=0; [[ $missing == 2 && $bad != 0 && $longrc != 0 && $arr != 0 && $intrc != 0 && ${invalid[0]} == keep && $integer == 3 ]] && good=1
mark invalid-arguments "$good"
ptybroker attach "$root" one observe h 2>>"$HOME/errors.log" || exit 1
exec 9>"$HOME/output"
t0=$(/usr/bin/python3 "$H" clock-ms)
ptybroker receive "$h" 9 ev 60000 2>>"$HOME/errors.log"; maxrc=$?
t1=$(/usr/bin/python3 "$H" clock-ms)
printf 'maximum_rc=%s maximum_elapsed_ms=%s maximum_event=%q\n' "$maxrc" "$((t1-t0))" "$ev" >>"$HOME/error-observation.txt"
good=0; [[ $maxrc == 0 && $ev == attached\ * ]] && ((t1-t0<2000)) && good=1
mark maximum-timeout-accepted "$good"
exec 8<&-
exec 7</dev/null
ptybroker receive "$h" 8 ev 100 >"$HOME/closed.out" 2>"$HOME/closed.err"; closed=$?
ptybroker receive "$h" 7 ev 100 >"$HOME/readonly.out" 2>"$HOME/readonly.err"; readonlyrc=$?
ptybroker send-fd "$root" one 8 count >"$HOME/input-closed.out" 2>"$HOME/input-closed.err"; inclosed=$?
printf 'closed_out_rc=%s readonly_out_rc=%s closed_in_rc=%s\n' "$closed" "$readonlyrc" "$inclosed" >>"$HOME/error-observation.txt"
good=0; [[ $closed != 0 && $readonlyrc != 0 && $inclosed != 0 ]] && good=1
mark closed-and-readonly-fds "$good"
t0=$(/usr/bin/python3 "$H" clock-ms)
ptybroker receive "$h" 9 ev >"$HOME/timeout.out" 2>"$HOME/timeout.err"; timeout_rc=$?
t1=$(/usr/bin/python3 "$H" clock-ms)
printf '%s %s\n' "$timeout_rc" "$((t1-t0))" >"$HOME/timing.log"
good=0; [[ $timeout_rc == 124 ]] && ((t1-t0>=75 && t1-t0<2000)) && good=1
mark default-idle-timeout "$good"
t0=$(/usr/bin/python3 "$H" clock-ms)
ptybroker receive "$h" 9 ev 35 >"$HOME/explicit-timeout.out" 2>"$HOME/explicit-timeout.err"; short_rc=$?
t1=$(/usr/bin/python3 "$H" clock-ms)
printf '%s %s\n' "$short_rc" "$((t1-t0))" >>"$HOME/timing.log"
good=0; [[ $short_rc == 124 ]] && ((t1-t0>=20 && t1-t0<2000)) && good=1
mark explicit-idle-timeout "$good"
ptybroker receive "$h" 9 ev 60001 >"$HOME/over.out" 2>"$HOME/over.err"; over=$?
printf 'default_timeout_rc=%s explicit_timeout_rc=%s over_limit_rc=%s\n' "$timeout_rc" "$short_rc" "$over" >>"$HOME/error-observation.txt"
good=0; [[ $over == 2 ]] && good=1
mark over-limit-rejected "$good"
ptybroker terminate "$root" one 2>>"$HOME/errors.log"; rc=$?
/usr/bin/python3 "$P" wait-gone "$HOME/broker-before.json" "$HOME/broker-after.json" broker >>"$HOME/proc.out" 2>>"$HOME/proc.err"; gone_rc=$?
printf 'terminate_rc=%s broker_disappearance_rc=%s\n' "$rc" "$gone_rc" >"$HOME/broker-cleanup-status.txt"
good=0; [[ $rc == 0 && $gone_rc == 0 && ! -e $root/one ]] && good=1
mark cleanup "$good"
exit "$failed"
cases.stdout:
invalid-arguments=PASS
maximum-timeout-accepted=PASS
closed-and-readonly-fds=PASS
default-idle-timeout=PASS
explicit-idle-timeout=PASS
over-limit-rejected=PASS
cleanup=PASS
